description: This Java class defines strategies for handling 'ConnectionCreated' commands within a connectivity messaging persistence layer. It extends a generic abstract command strategies class and implements singleton pattern to provide various predefined strategies for processing connection-related commands.

classes.name: ConnectionCreatedStrategies
classes.description: Defines a singleton class extending AbstractCommandStrategies to handle various connection commands, with specific strategies for handling connection creation events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionCreatedStrategies.

methods.name: newCreatedStrategies
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ConnectionCreatedStrategies and adds specific command handling strategies.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that the command is always considered defined for forwarding purposes.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands that are not explicitly managed, returning an error result indicating the connection is not accessible.
